title: Adjacent tape writes equal a concatenated write
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type, let $tape$ be a function from integer cells to optional symbols in $\Gamma$, let $o$ be an integer, and let $u$ and $v$ be finite words over $\Gamma$. Replacing the cells from $o$ through the end of $u$ with $u$, then the immediately following cells with $v$, and leaving all other cells as in $tape$ gives the same tape as writing the concatenated word $u\mathbin{++}v$ starting at $o$.
